title: Surrounded by Scrunchies
description:
Surrounded by Scrunchies is an adult visual novel about accidental cohabitation and pure seduction. When a unisex name mix-up gets our protagonist past the front door of a "Lady Bedspace Only" apartment, he finds himself living under the same roof with a house full of women. Sharing thin walls, tight spaces, and a single bathroom, watch as he secretly charms every tenant—saving the landlady for the ultimate finale.

Meet the Characters

● Vivienne (The Landlady): Easygoing and unsuspecting, Vivienne handed over the keys after assuming the new tenant was a girl. She runs the house with a relaxed attitude, completely unaware of the seductive chaos unfolding right under her nose.

● Luna: The shortest girl in the apartment, but easily the one with the biggest presence. Compact, energetic, and impossible to ignore during daily run-ins around the shared spaces.

● Sienna: Sweet, warm, and accommodating, Sienna is by far the kindest roommate in the building. Her soft nature makes her quick to lend a helping hand—and vulnerable to a little extra attention.

● Ariana: Highly defensive and quick to snap, Ariana is the resident tsundere. Behind her prickly exterior and sharp attitude lies a deeply lovable side just waiting to be uncovered.

Game Content:

● Linear Visual Novel Storyline

● Story-Driven Progression

● 2k Renders

● 18 Animations

Gameplay:

● Gallery

● Linear Progression

WARNING! This game is for ADULTS only and includes explicit sexual content that some viewers may find offensive. All characters depicted in the game are over 18 years of age.
